person.narrative: Working at a mid-size tech company, feeling ready for a change.

decision.question: What should I do with my career at this crossroads?

options.label: Pursue MBA
options.description: Leave job to attend a top-20 MBA program. 2-year program costing ~$150K total. Aiming for product management or consulting exit.

options.label: Co-found a startup
options.description: Leave job to co-found a B2B SaaS startup with a college friend. Initial funding from savings + small angel round. High risk, potentially high reward.

options.label: Stay and grow
options.description: Stay at current company, pursue promotion to senior engineer and eventually engineering manager. Stable path with predictable growth.

decision.context: Has 5 years of experience, strong technical skills, a partner who is supportive but risk-averse.
